newsitem.title: USA: Sequus trial shows positive amphotec result.
newsitem.headline: Sequus trial shows positive amphotec result.

text.p: Sequus Pharmaceuticals Inc said a random clinical trial of its Amphotec drug showed the drug equally effective and substantially less toxic to the kidney as compared to amphotericin B for treating febrile neutropenic patients.

The company also said the results showed Amphotec had a renal safety advantage over amphotericin B, the standard therapy for the patients, when used in conjunction with common anti-rejection therapy in both adults and children.
The company began marketing the drug on December 5. The FDA approved the drug on November 22, the company added.
